title: dactylorhiza traunsteineri subsp. bohemica
intro: Dactylorhiza traunsteineri subsp. bohemica, commonly known as the Bohemian marsh orchid, is a subspecies of orchid native to Europe. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The health benefits of Dactylorhiza traunsteineri subsp. bohemica are attributed to its ability to lower blood pressure, improve digestion, and reduce symptoms of respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
